facts.fact: Executive Order No. 163, an executive order signed by President Boakai on 22 April 2026, creates the National Digitalization and Modernization Initiative and the Office of Technology, Digitalization and Innovation, mandates interoperable digital systems across ministries, agencies and commissions, introduces a Government Interoperability Framework, and provides that data-sharing and interoperability initiatives be governed by formal agreements on access, use and accountability; the Observer reports it as signed, and says draft legislation to institutionalise it is due within 12 months.

note: An agreement between two agencies and an enrolment order are not a law on public bodies sharing data.
An ID registration order and NIR APIs for banks are not a law on public bodies sharing data.
